content.short: Camelot is an ecosystem-focused decentralized exchange and launchpad built on the Arbitrum network.
content.description: Camelot is a highly customizable decentralized exchange and growth hub natively built on Arbitrum, designed to provide long-term sustainable liquidity for the ecosystem. It utilizes a sophisticated AMM model that allows for flexible incentive structures and concentrated liquidity, ensuring that projects can tailor their pools to their specific needs. Beyond trading, Camelot features an integrated launchpad that helps emerging protocols bootstrap liquidity and build community support from day one. By focusing on deep integration with the Arbitrum network and prioritizing community-driven governance, Camelot has established itself as a critical pillar of infrastructure for decentralized finance and project innovation within the Layer 2 landscape.
content.meta: Camelot is the leading DEX and launchpad on Arbitrum, offering customizable liquidity solutions and a comprehensive growth hub for Web3 projects.
